page.notes: Printed "Damenum" in the heading-like entry is probably a misprint for "Dæmonum" and is copied as printed. "ambitio" has a blot over the i and is doubtful. The black dot before "Ultima" and the one in "ambitio" are stains, not reference marks. The lines "F." and "G." are partly cut off at the edge. Doubtful readings: "coactæ" (abbreviated word after "coa", marked [?]); "anfam" and "Eroës" read as printed; the F heading in the lower-left strip is partly obscured and marked [?]. Section headings H. and I. kept as paragraphs. Drop-cap initials G, I and F joined to the following word.
